# Release Tagging Guidelines

## Tag Format

- **Stable Release:** `v<major>.<minor>.<patch>`
    - Example: `v1.2.0`
- **Pre-release/Beta:** `v<major>.<minor>.<patch>-beta.<n>`
    - Example: `v1.3.0-beta.1`
- **Hotfix:** `v<major>.<minor>.<patch>-hotfix.<n>`
    - Example: `v1.2.1-hotfix.1`

## Recommendations

- Use [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).
- Tag annotated releases with changelog.
- Document breaking changes in release notes.
